parameters.query:
WITH next_job AS (
    SELECT id

    FROM automation_jobs

    WHERE job_type =
        'create_campaign_workspace'

      AND status = 'queued'

      AND available_at <= NOW()

      AND attempts < max_attempts

    ORDER BY
        available_at,
        created_at

    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

    LIMIT 1
),

claimed_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs j

    SET
        status = 'processing',
        attempts = j.attempts + 1,
        locked_at = NOW(),
        completed_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM next_job n

    WHERE j.id = n.id

    RETURNING
        j.id,
        j.campaign_id,
        j.campaign_version_id,
        j.approval_id,
        j.status,
        j.attempts
)

SELECT
    claimed_job.id::TEXT AS job_id,
    claimed_job.status AS job_status,
    claimed_job.attempts,

    c.id::TEXT AS campaign_id,
    c.campaign_code,
    c.brief,
    c.status AS campaign_status,
    c.drive_folder_id,

    cv.id::TEXT AS campaign_version_id,
    cv.version_number,
    cv.content AS approved_content,

    a.reviewer_name,
    a.reviewer_email,
    a.feedback AS approval_feedback,

    cl.client_code,
    cl.client_name,
    cl.company_name,
    cl.email AS client_email,
    cl.website

FROM claimed_job

JOIN campaigns c
    ON c.id = claimed_job.campaign_id

JOIN campaign_versions cv
    ON cv.id =
       claimed_job.campaign_version_id

JOIN approvals a
    ON a.id = claimed_job.approval_id

JOIN (
    SELECT
        id,
        client_code,
        name AS client_name,
        company_name,
        email,
        website
    FROM clients
) cl
    ON cl.id = c.client_id;

parameters.query:
WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

update_campaign AS (
    UPDATE campaigns

    SET drive_folder_id =
        input_data.data->>'folder_id'

    FROM input_data

    WHERE campaigns.id =
        (
          input_data.data
            ->>'campaign_id'
        )::UUID

    RETURNING
        campaigns.id,
        campaigns.campaign_code,
        campaigns.drive_folder_id
),

complete_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs

    SET
        status = 'completed',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        locked_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM input_data

    WHERE automation_jobs.id =
        (
          input_data.data
            ->>'job_id'
        )::UUID

      AND automation_jobs.status =
          'processing'

    RETURNING
        automation_jobs.id,
        automation_jobs.campaign_id,
        automation_jobs.status,
        automation_jobs.attempts,
        automation_jobs.completed_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '10 - Campaign Workspace Worker',

        complete_job.campaign_id,

        'info',

        'campaign_workspace_created',

        'The Google Drive campaign workspace was created.',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'job_id',
                complete_job.id,

            'folder_id',
                update_campaign.drive_folder_id,

            'campaign_code',
                update_campaign.campaign_code
        )

    FROM complete_job

    JOIN update_campaign
        ON update_campaign.id =
           complete_job.campaign_id

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    complete_job.id::TEXT AS job_id,
    complete_job.status AS job_status,
    complete_job.attempts,
    complete_job.completed_at,

    update_campaign.campaign_code,
    update_campaign.drive_folder_id

FROM complete_job

JOIN update_campaign
    ON update_campaign.id =
       complete_job.campaign_id;
